scope: All source floor dimensions and capsule standing/support queries are engine observations. Representative identity checks inspect actual StaticBody shapes and Label3D contents. GPU MultiMesh readback and saved viewport captures run only with a native renderer; headless dummy results defer them. Scenario starts are explicit test-only teleports; physical E, elevator ride, people animation/pause, and stair descent use production controllers. Authored profiles are game reconstructions, not surveyed interiors, public-access permissions, native-human-input acceptance, a full catalog walk-through, or a performance/export test.
